Analyzing the utilities use for one college campus seems trivial; however, a campus can be snapshot for the greater world around us. Here, I look into the utilities use and costs of different dorms and academic buildings on the campus of Sewanee: The University of the South. It can be concluded that making Sewanee a more sustainable campus comes through collaboration on the individual and systematic level: students can change their habits and the university administration could invest in more sustainable systems. This small model of working towards sustainability can be applied to much larger scales for real change.
